name: T5 Chicago II

profile.reading: This T5 Data Centers facility, T5 Chicago II, is located in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, in the Chicago metro area. T5 Data Centers is a data center developer and owner operating for nearly 2 decades, licensed as a general contractor in 48 states, with 22 data centers developed and more than 4 million square feet of data center space and 3 plus gigawatts of managed capacity across its portfolio as of the operator own most recent public figures. No facility specific address, square footage, or MW capacity for this Chicago area building is published in sourcing reachable this session.
